name: Besoins utilisateurs : podium des besoins les plus cochés (toute position confondue)
description: Lecture : X% des utilisateurs ayant rempli le questionnaire ont sélectionné cette proposition, quelle que soit sa position.
sql:
WITH comptes AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM tacct."user"
    WHERE roles NOT LIKE '%ROLE_ADMIN%'
      [[ AND {{periode}} ]]
),
repondants AS (
    -- dénominateur : utilisateurs non-admin ayant renseigné au moins un besoin
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ub.user_id) AS n
    FROM tacct.user_besoin ub
    JOIN comptes c ON c.id = ub.user_id
),
besoins (valeur, libelle) AS (
    VALUES
        ('data',        'Accéder à des données fiables sur mon territoire'),
        ('mobiliser',   'Mobiliser les acteurs de mon territoire'),
        ('diagnostic',  'Réviser le diagnostic de vulnérabilité'),
        ('method',      'Structurer ma démarche d’adaptation'),
        ('inspire',     'M’inspirer de retours d’expérience'),
        ('competences', 'Monter en compétences sur l’adaptation au changement climatique'),
        ('ressources',  'Trouver des ressources pour mener mes entretiens ou ateliers'),
        ('autre',       'Autre')
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ub.besoin)              AS "Position",
    COALESCE(b.libelle, ub.besoin)                                    AS "Proposition",
    COUNT(*)                                                          AS "Suffrages",
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ub.user_id) / NULLIF(r.n, 0), 1)     AS "Part (%)"
FROM tacct.user_besoin ub
JOIN comptes c ON c.id = ub.user_id
LEFT JOIN besoins b ON b.valeur = ub.besoin
CROSS JOIN repondants r
GROUP BY ub.besoin, b.libelle, r.n
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ub.besoin
LIMIT 3;

name: Clics sur les boutons de la page d'accueil / page mon-compte
description: Des évènements sur 3 boutons de la home page sont enregistrés : bouton "M'inscrire à une session d'accueil", "Découvrir le patch 4°C" et "Accéder aux ressources". Un évènement sur le header est enregistré : bouton "Mon compte". 2 évènements sur la page mon-compte sont enregistrés : boutons "M'inscrire à une session d'accueil" et "Me connecter". Un évènement est comptabilisé au clic.

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN event IN ('bouton_inscription_session_mon_compte', 'bouton_inscription_session_home') THEN 'Inscription session accueil'
        WHEN event = 'bouton_decouvrir_ressources_home' THEN 'Ressources'

FROM analytics.boutons_homepage
WHERE event != 'bouton_evaluer_diagnostic_home'

name: Complétion des questionnaires
sql:
WITH comptes AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM tacct."user"
    WHERE roles NOT LIKE '%ROLE_ADMIN%'
      [[ AND {{periode}} ]]
),
questionnaires AS (
    SELECT
        a.user_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.question_key)                     AS nb_reponses,
        COUNT(DISTINCT split_part(a.question_key, '.', 1)) AS nb_criteres,
        MIN(split_part(a.question_key, '.', 1))            AS critere_unique,
        MIN(a.created_at)                                  AS demarre_le
    FROM tacct.tacctoscope_answer a
    JOIN comptes c ON c.id = a.user_id
    GROUP BY a.user_id
)
SELECT t."Indicateur", t."Valeur"
FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS ordre,
           'Questionnaires limités au critère « Données climatiques »' AS "Indicateur",
           COUNT(*)::numeric AS "Valeur"
    FROM questionnaires
    WHERE nb_criteres = 1 AND critere_unique = 'donnees-climatiques'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Questionnaires complétés à 100 %', COUNT(*)::numeric
    FROM questionnaires WHERE nb_reponses >= 25

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Complétion moyenne des questionnaires démarrés il y a plus d''un mois (%)',
           ROUND(AVG(nb_reponses::numeric) / 25 * 100, 1)
    FROM questionnaires WHERE demarre_le < now() - INTERVAL '1 month'
) t
ORDER BY t.ordre;

name: Conversion à l'étape 2 (depuis le 9/12)
description: Calcul du taux de conversion entre les deux étapes du parcours. La requête identifie les utilisateurs qui ont visité la page /donnees avec une thématique spécifique (étape 1) depuis le 9 décembre, puis vérifie combien ont ensuite cliqué sur un bouton de diagnostic pour la même thématique (étape 2).
sql:
WITH thematiques AS (
    SELECT UNNEST(ARRAY['Confort+thermique', 'Agriculture']) AS thematique_url,
           UNNEST(ARRAY['Confort thermique', 'Agriculture']) AS thematique_nom
),
etape1 AS (
    -- users uniques par thématique qui ont visité /donnees à partir du 09/12/2025
    -- UNIQUEMENT pour les thématiques spécifiées
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        p.distinct_id,
        t.thematique_nom
    FROM (
        SELECT distinct_id, current_url
        FROM analytics.all_pageview_raw
        WHERE current_url LIKE '%/donnees%'
            AND event_timestamp >= '2025-12-09 00:00:00'::timestamptz
            AND distinct_id IS NOT NULL
            AND distinct_id != ''
            [[ AND {{periode}} ]]
    ) p
    INNER JOIN thematiques t ON p.current_url LIKE '%thematique=' || t.thematique_url || '%'
),
etape2 AS (
    -- users uniques qui ont cliqué sur un bouton étape 2
    -- UNIQUEMENT pour les thématiques spécifiées
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        distinct_id,
        properties->>'thematique' AS thematique
    FROM analytics.boutons_etape2
    WHERE (properties->>'thematique' = 'Confort thermique' 
           OR properties->>'thematique' = 'Agriculture')
        AND distinct_id IS NOT NULL
        AND distinct_id != ''
        [[ AND {{periode_etape2}} ]]
),
conversion AS (
    -- users présents dans les deux étapes, en matchant sur la thématique
    SELECT 
        e1.distinct_id,
        e1.thematique_nom
    FROM etape1 e1
    INNER JOIN etape2 e2 ON e1.distinct_id = e2.distinct_id 
        AND e1.thematique_nom = e2.thematique
)
SELECT 
    e1.thematique_nom AS thematique,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e1.distinct_id) AS users_etape1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.distinct_id) AS users_converties,
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(DISTINCT c.distinct_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e1.distinct_id), 0)) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS taux_conversion
FROM etape1 e1
LEFT JOIN conversion c ON e1.distinct_id = c.distinct_id AND e1.thematique_nom = c.thematique_nom
GROUP BY e1.thematique_nom
ORDER BY e1.thematique_nom;

name: Liste des territoires les plus recherchés
description: Cette table montre l'occurrence des recherches pour chaque territoire.
sql:
SELECT 
    code_geographique,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_total,
    MAX(libelle_geographique) AS libelle_geographique
FROM (
    -- Nouvelles URLs
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN (regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)'))[1] IN ('petr', 'ept') 
            THEN (regexp_match(current_url, 'libelle=([^&]+)'))[1]
            ELSE (regexp_match(current_url, 'code=([^&]+)'))[1]
        END AS code_geographique,
        (
            SELECT string_agg(
                CASE WHEN m[1] IS NOT NULL 
                    THEN convert_from(decode(replace(m[1], '%',''), 'hex'), 'UTF8') ELSE m[2]
                    END, '' ORDER BY ord
                )
            FROM regexp_matches(replace(
                (regexp_match(current_url, 'libelle=([^&]+)'))[1], '+', ' '), '((?:%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2})+)|([^%]+)', 'g'
            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS q(m, ord)
        ) AS libelle_geographique
    FROM analytics.all_pageview_raw
    WHERE current_url LIKE '%/donnees%'
      [[ AND {{periode}} ]]
      AND current_url LIKE '%thematique%'
      AND current_url LIKE '%type%'
      AND current_url LIKE '%libelle%'
      AND regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          ( (regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)'))[1] IN ('petr', 'ept') 
            AND regexp_match(current_url, 'libelle=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL )
          OR
          ( (regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)'))[1] NOT IN ('petr', 'ept') 
            AND regexp_match(current_url, 'code=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL )
      )
    
    UNION ALL
    -- Anciennes URLs
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN regexp_match(current_url, 'codgeo=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL 
            THEN (regexp_match(current_url, 'codgeo=([^&]+)'))[1]
            ELSE (regexp_match(current_url, 'codepci=([^&]+)'))[1]
        END AS code_geographique,
        NULL AS libelle_geographique
    FROM analytics.all_pageview_raw
    WHERE current_url LIKE '%/donnees%'
      [[ AND {{periode}} ]]
      AND current_url LIKE '%thematique%'
      AND (current_url LIKE '%codepci%' OR current_url LIKE '%codgeo%')
      AND (
          (regexp_match(current_url, 'codgeo=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL)
          OR
          (regexp_match(current_url, 'codepci=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL)
      )
) AS searches
GROUP BY code_geographique
ORDER BY nombre_total DESC;

name: Nombre de territoires recherchés par type
description:

- 1 254 EPCI
- 34 875 communes
- 122 PETR
- 59 PNR
- 11 EPT
- 101 départements
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT territory_id) AS "visités",
        CASE
            type
            WHEN 'commune' THEN 34875
            WHEN 'epci' THEN 1254
            WHEN 'petr' THEN 122
            WHEN 'pnr' THEN 59
            WHEN 'ept' THEN 11
            WHEN 'departement' THEN 103
            ELSE NULL
        END AS "Nombre total",
        ROUND(
            (COUNT(DISTINCT territory_id) * 100.0) / CASE
                type
                WHEN 'commune' THEN 34875
                WHEN 'epci' THEN 1254
                WHEN 'petr' THEN 122
                WHEN 'pnr' THEN 59
                WHEN 'ept' THEN 11
                WHEN 'departement' THEN 103
                ELSE NULL
            END,
            2
        ) AS "Part de territoires visités"
    FROM
        (
            -- Nouvelles URLs
            SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)')) [1] IN ('petr', 'ept') THEN (regexp_match(current_url, 'libelle=([^&]+)')) [1]
                    ELSE (regexp_match(current_url, 'code=([^&]+)')) [1]
                END AS territory_id,
                (regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)')) [1] AS type
            FROM
                analytics.all_pageview_raw
            WHERE
                current_url LIKE '%/donnees%'
                AND current_url LIKE '%thematique%'
                AND current_url LIKE '%type%'
                AND current_url LIKE '%libelle%'
                AND regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL
                AND (
                    (
                        (regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)')) [1] IN ('petr', 'ept')
                        AND regexp_match(current_url, 'libelle=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    OR (
                        (regexp_match(current_url, 'type=([^&]+)')) [1] NOT IN ('petr', 'ept')
                        AND regexp_match(current_url, 'code=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL
                    )
                )
                [[ AND {{periode}} ]]
            UNION
            -- Anciennes URLs
            SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN regexp_match(current_url, 'codgeo=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL THEN (regexp_match(current_url, 'codgeo=([^&]+)')) [1]
                    ELSE (regexp_match(current_url, 'codepci=([^&]+)')) [1]
                END AS territory_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN regexp_match(current_url, 'codgeo=([^&]+)') IS NOT NULL THEN 'commune'
                    ELSE 'epci'
                END AS type
            FROM
                analytics.all_pageview_raw
            WHERE
                current_url LIKE '%/donnees%'
                AND current_url LIKE '%thematique%'

WITH comptes AS (

    WHERE 1 = 1
      [[ AND {{periode}} ]]
),
participants AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT rp.user_id
    FROM reponses_periode rp
    JOIN comptes c ON c.id = rp.user_id
),
criteres (ordre, slug, libelle, nb_questions) AS (

        (1, 'donnees-climatiques',            'Données climatiques',            5),
        (2, 'donnees-socio-economiques',      'Données socio-économiques',      5),

        (4, 'priorisation-des-impacts',       'Priorisation des impacts',       3),
        (5, 'problematisation-et-conclusion', 'Problématisation et conclusion', 3)
),

    SELECT split_part(rp.question_key, '.', 1) AS slug, COUNT(*) AS nb
    FROM reponses_periode rp

    , 1) AS "Non complétion (%)"
FROM criteres c

LEFT JOIN reponses r ON r.slug = c.slug
ORDER BY c.ordre;

WITH base AS (
  -- 1) Pages cibles et découpe URL
  SELECT
    session_id,
    person_id,
    event_timestamp,
    current_url,
    properties,
    lower(split_part(regexp_replace(current_url, '^https?://[^/]+', ''), '?', 1)) AS raw_path,
    split_part(regexp_replace(current_url, '^https?://[^/]+', ''), '?', 2) AS qs
  FROM analytics.all_pageview_raw
  WHERE current_url ILIKE '%/thematiques%'
     OR current_url ILIKE '%/donnees-territoriales%'
     OR current_url ILIKE '%/donnees%'
),

kv AS (
  -- 2) Querystring → paires key=value
  SELECT
    b.session_id, b.person_id, b.event_timestamp, b.current_url, b.properties, b.raw_path, b.qs,
    regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(b.qs, ''), '&') AS pair
  FROM base b
),

kv_parsed AS (
  -- 3) Séparation clé / valeur
  SELECT
    session_id, person_id, event_timestamp, current_url, properties, raw_path,
    lower(split_part(pair, '=', 1)) AS k,
    NULLIF(split_part(pair, '=', 2), '') AS v
  FROM kv
),

params AS (
  -- 4) Pivot des clés utiles
  SELECT
    session_id, person_id, event_timestamp, current_url, properties,
    regexp_replace(raw_path, '/+$', '') AS path_norm,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'type')                       AS p_type,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'code')                       AS p_code,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'libelle')                    AS p_libelle,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k IN ('thematique','thématique')) AS p_thematique,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'codgeo')                     AS p_codgeo,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'codepci')                    AS p_codepci
  FROM kv_parsed
  GROUP BY session_id, person_id, event_timestamp, current_url, properties, raw_path
),

normalized AS (
  -- 5) Normalisations + mapping ancien/nouveau schéma
  SELECT
    session_id,
    person_id,
    event_timestamp,
    current_url,
    properties,
    path_norm,

    -- prev pathname normalisé depuis 3 sources
    regexp_replace(
      lower(
        COALESCE(
          properties->>'$prev_pageview_pathname',
          properties->>'$prev_pathname',
          NULLIF(split_part(regexp_replace(COALESCE(properties->>'$prev_url',''), '^https?://[^/]+', ''), '?', 1), '')
        )
      ),
      '/+$', ''
    ) AS prev_path_norm,

    CASE
      WHEN p_codgeo IS NOT NULL AND p_codepci IS NOT NULL THEN 'commune'
      WHEN p_codgeo IS NULL  AND p_codepci IS NOT NULL THEN 'epci'
      ELSE NULLIF(p_type, '')
    END AS type_norm,

    CASE
      WHEN p_codgeo IS NOT NULL AND p_codepci IS NOT NULL THEN p_codgeo
      WHEN p_codgeo IS NULL  AND p_codepci IS NOT NULL THEN p_codepci
      ELSE NULLIF(p_code, '')
    END AS code_norm,

    NULLIF(replace(COALESCE(p_libelle, ''), '+', ' '), '')    AS libelle_norm,
    NULLIF(replace(COALESCE(p_thematique, ''), '+', ' '), '') AS thematique
  FROM params
),

eligible_sessions AS (
  -- 6) Sessions qui respectent le "tunnel"
  SELECT session_id
  FROM normalized
  GROUP BY session_id
  HAVING
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/donnees-territoriales') > 0
     OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/donnees') > 0)
    AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/thematiques') > 0
    AND (
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE (path_norm = '/donnees-territoriales' OR path_norm = '/donnees')
          AND prev_path_norm = '/thematiques'
      ) > 0
      OR (
        MIN(event_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/thematiques')
        <
        LEAST(
          COALESCE(MIN(event_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/thematiques'), 'infinity'::timestamp),
          COALESCE(MIN(event_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/donnees-territoriales'), 'infinity'::timestamp),
          COALESCE(MIN(event_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/donnees'), 'infinity'::timestamp)
        )
      )
    )
),

clean AS (
  -- 7) Événements DT des sessions éligibles ; autorise (code OU libelle) avec type non null
  SELECT
    n.session_id,
    n.person_id,
    n.event_timestamp,
    n.current_url,
    n.path_norm,
    n.type_norm    AS type,
    n.code_norm    AS code,
    n.libelle_norm AS libelle,
    n.thematique,
    CASE
      WHEN n.code_norm IS NOT NULL THEN 'code:'  || n.code_norm
      ELSE 'label:' || n.libelle_norm
    END AS territory_key
  FROM normalized n
  JOIN eligible_sessions es USING (session_id)
  WHERE (n.path_norm = '/donnees-territoriales' OR n.path_norm = '/donnees')
    AND n.type_norm IS NOT NULL
    AND (n.code_norm IS NOT NULL OR n.libelle_norm IS NOT NULL)
),

per_session_territory AS (
  -- 8) Dédup par (session, type, territory_key) + date de session (Europe/Paris)
  SELECT
    session_id,
    type,
    territory_key,
    MAX(code)    FILTER (WHERE code IS NOT NULL) AS code_any,
    COALESCE(MAX(libelle) FILTER (WHERE libelle IS NOT NULL AND libelle <> ''), '') AS libelle_any,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS first_ts,
    -- date locale (Europe/Paris) de la session pour ce territoire
    (MIN(event_timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS session_day,
    array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(thematique, '')) FILTER (WHERE thematique IS NOT NULL AND thematique <> '') AS session_thematiques,
    array_agg(DISTINCT current_url) AS session_urls_dt
  FROM clean
  GROUP BY session_id, type, territory_key
),

sessions_by_day AS (
  -- 9) Nb de sessions par jour et territoire
  SELECT
    type,
    territory_key,
    session_day,
    COUNT(*) AS sessions_day
  FROM per_session_territory
  GROUP BY type, territory_key, session_day
),

themes_first_day AS (
  -- 10) Pour chaque thématique d’un territoire : son premier jour d’apparition
  SELECT
    type,
    territory_key,
    t AS thematique,
    MIN(session_day) AS theme_first_day
  FROM (
    SELECT
      type,
      territory_key,
      session_day,
      unnest(session_thematiques) AS t
    FROM per_session_territory
  ) u
  GROUP BY type, territory_key, t
),

cumulative AS (
  -- 11) Cumuls par territoire et jour :
  --     - cum_sessions : cumul des sessions
  --     - cum_thematiques : nb de thématiques dont le premier jour <= jour courant
  SELECT
    d.type,
    d.territory_key,
    d.session_day AS day,
    SUM(d.sessions_day) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.type, d.territory_key
      ORDER BY d.session_day
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cum_sessions,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM themes_first_day tf
      WHERE tf.type = d.type
        AND tf.territory_key = d.territory_key
        AND tf.theme_first_day <= d.session_day
    ) AS cum_thematiques
  FROM sessions_by_day d
),

-- 12) Premier jour (unlock_day) où le territoire atteint les 2 seuils
unlocks AS (
  SELECT
    type,
    territory_key,
    MIN(day) AS unlock_day
  FROM cumulative
  WHERE cum_sessions >= 3
    AND cum_thematiques >= 3
  GROUP BY type, territory_key
),

-- 13) Comptage par jour
counts AS (
  SELECT unlock_day::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS north_star
  FROM unlocks
  GROUP BY 1
),

-- 14) Série de dates (Europe/Paris) du 1er jour observé à aujourd'hui
series AS (
  SELECT d::date AS day
  FROM generate_series(
    COALESCE((SELECT MIN(day) FROM counts),
             (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date),
    (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) AS g(d)
),
final_daily AS (          
  SELECT s.day, COALESCE(c.north_star, 0) AS north_star
  FROM series s
  LEFT JOIN counts c USING (day)
)

SELECT
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM {{grain}}) || ' ' ||
  CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM {{grain}})
    WHEN 1 THEN 'janvier'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'février'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'mars'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'avril'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'mai'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'juin'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'juillet'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'août'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'septembre'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'octobre'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'novembre'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'décembre'

    NULLIF(split_part(pair, '=', 2), '') AS v
  FROM kv
),

  SELECT
    session_id, person_id, event_timestamp, current_url, properties,
    regexp_replace(raw_path, '/+$', '') AS path_norm,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'type')                       AS p_type,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'code')                       AS p_code,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'libelle')                    AS p_libelle,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k IN ('thematique','thématique')) AS p_thematique,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'codgeo')                     AS p_codgeo,
    MAX(v) FILTER (WHERE k = 'codepci')                    AS p_codepci
  FROM kv_parsed
  GROUP BY session_id, person_id, event_timestamp, current_url, properties, raw_path
),

  -- 5) Normalisations + mapping ancien/nouveau schéma
  SELECT
    session_id,
    person_id,
    event_timestamp,
    current_url,
    properties,
    path_norm,

    regexp_replace(
      lower(
        COALESCE(
          properties->>'$prev_pageview_pathname',
          properties->>'$prev_pathname',
          NULLIF(split_part(regexp_replace(COALESCE(properties->>'$prev_url',''), '^https?://[^/]+', ''), '?', 1), '')

      WHEN p_codgeo IS NOT NULL AND p_codepci IS NOT NULL THEN 'commune'
      WHEN p_codgeo IS NULL  AND p_codepci IS NOT NULL THEN 'epci'
      ELSE NULLIF(p_type, '')
    END AS type_norm,

    CASE
      WHEN p_codgeo IS NOT NULL AND p_codepci IS NOT NULL THEN p_codgeo
      WHEN p_codgeo IS NULL  AND p_codepci IS NOT NULL THEN p_codepci
      ELSE NULLIF(p_code, '')
    END AS code_norm,

    NULLIF(replace(COALESCE(p_thematique, ''), '+', ' '), '') AS thematique
  FROM params
),

  -- 6) Sessions qui respectent le "tunnel"
  SELECT session_id
  FROM normalized
  GROUP BY session_id
  HAVING
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/donnees-territoriales') > 0
     OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/donnees') > 0)
    AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/thematiques') > 0
    AND (
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE (path_norm = '/donnees-territoriales' OR path_norm = '/donnees')
          AND prev_path_norm = '/thematiques'
      ) > 0
      OR (
        MIN(event_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/thematiques')
        <

          COALESCE(MIN(event_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE path_norm = '/thematiques'), 'infinity'::timestamp),

  -- 7) Événements DT des sessions éligibles ; autorise (code OU libelle) avec type non null
  SELECT
    n.session_id,
    n.person_id,
    n.event_timestamp,
    n.current_url,
    n.path_norm,
    n.type_norm    AS type,
    n.code_norm    AS code,
    n.libelle_norm AS libelle,

    END AS territory_key
  FROM normalized n

  WHERE (n.path_norm = '/donnees-territoriales' OR n.path_norm = '/donnees')
    AND n.type_norm IS NOT NULL
    AND (n.code_norm IS NOT NULL OR n.libelle_norm IS NOT NULL)
),

per_session_territory AS (
  -- 8) Dédup par (session, type, territory_key) + date de session (Europe/Paris)
  SELECT
    session_id,
    type,
    territory_key,
    MAX(code)    FILTER (WHERE code IS NOT NULL) AS code_any,
    COALESCE(MAX(libelle) FILTER (WHERE libelle IS NOT NULL AND libelle <> ''), '') AS libelle_any,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS first_ts,
    -- date locale (Europe/Paris) de la session pour ce territoire
    (MIN(event_timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS session_day,
    array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(thematique, '')) FILTER (WHERE thematique IS NOT NULL AND thematique <> '') AS session_thematiques,
    array_agg(DISTINCT current_url) AS session_urls_dt
  FROM clean
  GROUP BY session_id, type, territory_key
),

sessions_by_day AS (
  -- 9) Nb de sessions par jour et territoire
  SELECT
    type,
    territory_key,
    session_day,
    COUNT(*) AS sessions_day
  FROM per_session_territory
  GROUP BY type, territory_key, session_day
),

themes_first_day AS (
  -- 10) Pour chaque thématique d’un territoire : son premier jour d’apparition
  SELECT
    type,
    territory_key,
    t AS thematique,
    MIN(session_day) AS theme_first_day
  FROM (
    SELECT
      type,
      territory_key,
      session_day,
      unnest(session_thematiques) AS t
    FROM per_session_territory
  ) u
  GROUP BY type, territory_key, t
),

cumulative AS (
  -- 11) Cumuls par territoire et jour :
  --     - cum_sessions : cumul des sessions
  --     - cum_thematiques : nb de thématiques dont le premier jour <= jour courant
  SELECT
    d.type,
    d.territory_key,
    d.session_day AS day,
    SUM(d.sessions_day) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.type, d.territory_key
      ORDER BY d.session_day
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cum_sessions,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM themes_first_day tf
      WHERE tf.type = d.type
        AND tf.territory_key = d.territory_key
        AND tf.theme_first_day <= d.session_day
    ) AS cum_thematiques
  FROM sessions_by_day d
),

-- 12) Premier jour (unlock_day) où le territoire atteint les 2 seuils
unlocks AS (
  SELECT
    type,
    territory_key,
    MIN(day) AS unlock_day
  FROM cumulative
  WHERE cum_sessions >= 3
    AND cum_thematiques >= 3
  GROUP BY type, territory_key
),

-- 13) Comptage par jour
counts AS (
  SELECT unlock_day::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS north_star
  FROM unlocks
  GROUP BY 1
),

-- 14) Série de dates (Europe/Paris) du 1er jour observé à aujourd'hui
series AS (
  SELECT d::date AS day
  FROM generate_series(
    COALESCE((SELECT MIN(day) FROM counts),
             (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date),
    (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) AS g(d)
),
final_daily AS (          
  SELECT s.day, COALESCE(c.north_star, 0) AS north_star
  FROM series s
  LEFT JOIN counts c USING (day)
)

sql:
WITH config AS (
    SELECT 21 AS nb_questions          -- ← le seul endroit à modifier
),
comptes AS (
    SELECT id, profil FROM tacct."user" WHERE roles NOT LIKE '%ROLE_ADMIN%'
),
questionnaires AS (
    SELECT
        a.user_id,
        c.profil,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.question_key)                     AS nb_reponses,
        COUNT(DISTINCT split_part(a.question_key, '.', 1)) AS nb_criteres,
        MIN(split_part(a.question_key, '.', 1))            AS critere_unique,
        MIN(a.created_at)                                  AS demarre_le
    FROM tacct.tacctoscope_answer a
    JOIN comptes c ON c.id = a.user_id
    GROUP BY a.user_id, c.profil
)
SELECT t."Indicateur", t."Valeur"
FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS ordre,
           'Questionnaires dont plus de la moitié des questions ont été répondues (≥ '
             || ceil((SELECT nb_questions FROM config) / 2.0)::int
             || ' / ' || (SELECT nb_questions FROM config) || ')' AS "Indicateur",
           COUNT(*)::numeric AS "Valeur"
    FROM questionnaires
    WHERE nb_reponses > (SELECT nb_questions FROM config) / 2.0

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Questionnaires limités au critère « Données climatiques »', COUNT(*)::numeric
    FROM questionnaires
    WHERE nb_criteres = 1 AND critere_unique = 'donnees-climatiques'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Questionnaires limités au critère « Données climatiques » (CdM, élus et responsables)',
           COUNT(*)::numeric
    FROM questionnaires
    WHERE nb_criteres = 1
      AND critere_unique = 'donnees-climatiques'
      AND profil IN ('cdm', 'elu', 'responsable')

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Questionnaires complétés à 100 %', COUNT(*)::numeric
    FROM questionnaires
    WHERE nb_reponses >= (SELECT nb_questions FROM config)

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 5, 'Complétion moyenne des questionnaires démarrés il y a plus d''un mois (%)',
           ROUND(AVG(nb_reponses::numeric) / (SELECT nb_questions FROM config) * 100, 1)
    FROM questionnaires WHERE demarre_le < now() - INTERVAL '1 month'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 6, 'Nombre total de questionnaires démarrés', COUNT(*)::numeric
    FROM questionnaires
) t
ORDER BY t.ordre;

name: (TACCToscope) Consultations de la feuille de route
description: Additionner le pourcentage des résultats 50 et 100 = X% des utilisateurs du TACCToscope consultent la feuille de route au moins 1 fois sur 2
sql:
WITH sessions AS (
    SELECT
        session_id,
        max(properties ->> 'user_id') AS user_id,
        bool_or(properties ->> 'est_connecte' = 'true') AS connectee,
        bool_or(current_url LIKE '%/tacctoscope/feuille-de-route%') AS a_vu_feuille_de_route
    FROM analytics.all_pageview_raw
    WHERE session_id <> ''
      [[ AND {{periode}} ]]
    GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT
    s.user_id                                           AS "Identifiant de l'utilisateur",
    count(*)                                            AS "Nombre de sessions connectées",
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.a_vu_feuille_de_route)     AS "Sessions avec consultation de la feuille de route",
    round(
        100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.a_vu_feuille_de_route) / count(*),
        1
    )                                                   AS "Part des sessions avec feuille de route (%)"
FROM sessions s
WHERE s.connectee
  AND s.user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.user_id
ORDER BY "Part des sessions avec feuille de route (%)" DESC,
         "Nombre de sessions connectées" DESC;

name: (TACCToscope) Non complétion par critère
sql:
WITH comptes AS (
    SELECT id FROM tacct."user" WHERE roles NOT LIKE '%ROLE_ADMIN%'
),
participants AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.user_id
    FROM tacct.tacctoscope_answer a 
    JOIN comptes c ON c.id = a.user_id
),
criteres (ordre, slug, libelle) AS (
    VALUES
        (1, 'donnees-climatiques',            'Données climatiques'),
        (2, 'donnees-socio-economiques',      'Données socio-économiques'),
        (3, 'dialogue-et-partage',            'Dialogue et partage'),
        (4, 'priorisation-des-impacts',       'Priorisation des impacts'),
        (5, 'problematisation-et-conclusion', 'Problématisation et conclusion')
),
reponses AS (
    SELECT split_part(a.question_key, '.', 1) AS slug, COUNT(*) AS nb
    FROM tacct.tacctoscope_answer a
    JOIN participants p ON p.user_id = a.user_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    c.libelle AS "Critère",
    ROUND(
        100 - COALESCE(r.nb, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(t.total * 5, 0) * 100
    , 1) AS "Non complétion (%)"
FROM criteres c
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM participants) t
LEFT JOIN reponses r ON r.slug = c.slug
ORDER BY c.ordre;
